# Fictional base resumes (recruiter plan R3)

Every person, employer, school, and contact detail here is invented. They exist to prove that tailoring keeps each candidate's own format, whatever its length or layout. Tests: `tests/resume-formats.test.ts`.

| File | Candidate | Field | Shape |
|---|---|---|---|
| `half-page-retail.md` | Jordan Lee | Retail to operations | Half a page, 2 roles, short bullets |
| `one-page-summary-sales.md` | Sam Rivera | Sales | Summary, "Core Competencies", "Work Experience" |
| `two-page-nursing.md` | Taylor Brooks | Nursing | Two pages, 5 roles, licenses and certifications after Education |
| `experience-first-finance.md` | Casey Nguyen | Finance | Experience, then Skills, then Education |
| `education-first-graduate.md` | Riley Park | Recent graduate, marketing | Education first, then Experience, then Skills |

The last two are layouts the parser doesn't read yet; their tests are marked as known gaps until R3.
